Struct NoteOrigin

pub struct NoteOrigin {
    pub tx_hash: Field,
    pub block: BlockReference,
}

Where a settled note was created.

None of this can be cheaply constrained: doing so requires proving the transaction, its inclusion in the block, and the block's ancestry in the anchor block.

Fields

tx_hash: Field

Hash of the transaction that created the note.

block: BlockReference

The block that transaction was included in.
